recent.text: I know you're busy with your projects, Sir, but since you've expressed interest in improving your guitar playing, I had a thought: we could write a simple script that generates random notes for you to identify on your fretboard. It could turn your practice into a quick, interactive game whenever you have a moment to spare—would you be interested in that later?

Since you're still working on that cinematic Three.js interface, Sir, I had a thought: we could add a 'workspace widget' that dynamically displays the last file you modified in your active project folders. It would give you an at-a-glance update on your progress without needing to switch windows. What do you think?

I apologize for the confusion earlier, Sir. Looking at your currently open windows—specifically the terminal titled 'Designed PowerPoint generation', your `personality.js` file in VS Code, and your notes on the document tool—it's clear you're focused on refining the document generation architecture right now. You are deep into the implementation details for those PowerPoint features.

It would be a perfect practical test for your new generator and a helpful way to organize your tasks for Monday.
Sleep well, Sir. I hope you get some good rest to be ready for your classes tomorrow. I'll be right here keeping watch if you need anything when you return.
